name: National Scheme of Incentive to Girls for Secondary Education (NSIGSE)
benefit_summary: Fixed deposit of ₹3,000 in the name of the girl student upon enrollment in Class IX, redeemable with accrued interest (approx ₹10,000) on passing Class X and attaining age 18.
who_can_apply_intro: All eligible citizens who meet the National Scheme of Incentive to Girls for Secondary Education (NSIGSE) guidelines.
application_steps: Check that your Aadhaar card and active bank passbook are ready.
Visit the official portal or your local Common Service Centre (CSC) / Panchayat office.
Fill in the application details and complete your biometric or OTP e-KYC.
Receive your application reference number to track verification and direct payment status.
